items.t: Quinine, IV (1 mL = 300 mg quinine salt). • Loading dose: 20 mg/kg in dextrose 5% administered over 4 hours. • Maintenance dose: 8 hours after start of the loading dose, give 10 mg/kg in dextrose
Quinine, oral, 10 mg/kg/dose 8 hourly for 7–10 days.
Quinine, oral, 10 mg/kg/dose 8 hourly to complete 7–10 day course.

adjustments.t: Can be used; watch for hypoglycaemia

cautions.t: Never give as an IV bolus
Reduce maintenance dose after 48 hours in renal failure

adverse_effects.t: Cinchonism (tinnitus, deafness, nausea, visual disturbance), hypoglycaemia, QT prolongation, hypotension if infused fast
